rha_dataset.paper_title: Performance of Sustainable Green Concrete Incorporated with Fly Ash, Rice Husk Ash, and Stone Dust
rha_dataset.authors: Siddika, Amin, Rayhan, Islam, Al Mamun, Alyousef, Amran
rha_dataset.country_region: Bangladesh (Pabna University of Science and Technology)
rha_dataset.rha_source_location: RHA from different mills and factories, Bangladesh (ground, 150 mesh; uncontrolled burning, high carbon)
rha_dataset.material_type: Concrete (1:2:4) with FA+RHA replacing cement, stone dust replacing sand
rha_dataset.output_availability: figure_only for comp & split tensile; flexural computed from stated %+range
rha_dataset.value_source: kg/m3 from Table 2 (verbatim). Flexural COMPUTED from stated reductions (16.4/12.93/9.48/8.62%) and stated range 2.91-3.18 MPa => control 3.48. Comp & split absolute only in Fig 5/8 (not tabulated, no control absolute) -> left blank.
rha_dataset.notes: Binder (cement+FA+RHA) = 380 kg/m3 for all mixes; water 190 kg/m3 -> w/binder 0.5. RHA% = RHA/(binder). FA also replaces cement; stone dust (SD) replaces fine aggregate. Comp strength reductions vs control: 11.42/3.99/6.50/3.49% (F5R10S0/F10R5S0/F10R10S5/F5R5S10) but control comp absolute not given numerically -> comp left blank. Split reductions 14.16/9.74/8.41/7.52% similarly figure-only.
rha_dataset.evidence: Table 2 mix proportion kg/m3. Flexural: 'between 2.91 and 3.18 MPa', reductions 16.4/12.93/9.48/8.62% => control 3.48, F5R10S0 2.91, F10R5S0 3.03, F10R10S5 3.15, F5R5S10 3.18. All tests at 28 days.

mixes.other_additives: Fly ash 38 kg/m3 (10%); stone dust 38 kg/m3 (5% of sand)
Fly ash 19 kg/m3 (5%); stone dust 76 kg/m3 (10% of sand)

rha_dataset.paper_title: Partial replacement of cement with rice husk ash in concrete production: an exploratory cost-benefit analysis for low-income communities
rha_dataset.rha_source_location: Rice husk from National Milling Company (NMC), Zambia; burnt in incinerator at 600C, pulverised
rha_dataset.material_type: Concrete (normal), two w/c series 0.3 and 0.5; no superplasticizer
rha_dataset.value_source: Cement kg/m3 from Table 5 design binder (400 for 0.3 series, 270 for 0.5 series), split into cement+RHA by % (binder constant per series). Fine/coarse/water kg/m3 COMPUTED from batch masses (sand 13.2 kg, stone 26.4 kg, water 4 or 4.57 kg) divided by batch volume (=binder_batch/binder_density: 8.8/400=0.022 m3 for 0.3; 7.74/270=0.02867 m3 for 0.5). Comp strength verbatim Table 5.
rha_dataset.notes: Only 28-day strengths for main mixes (trial 7-day not tabulated). Stated w/c (0.3, 0.5) is nominal/design; batch-derived water/binder differs (4/8.8=0.45 for 0.3 series; 4.57/7.74=0.59 for 0.5 series) - recorded nominal w/c, see this note. Aggregate kg/m3 computed (sand 600 / stone 1200 for 0.3 series; sand 460 / stone 921 for 0.5 series). No flexural or split tensile tested.
rha_dataset.evidence: Table 5: 0.3 series binder 8.8 kg batch=400 kg/m3, comp 33/25/16 MPa at RHA 0/10/20%; 0.5 series binder 7.74 kg=270 kg/m3, comp 25/22/18/14 MPa at RHA 0/10/20/30%. Sand 13.2 kg, stone 26.4 kg per batch (all mixes).
